text_block_list.text: I messed up…

text_block_list.text: But a minor injury like this'll heal up in a jiffy!
choice_data_list: You should get some proper rest, even if it is minor.
There's that youthful resilience! Let's get back to training!

text_block_list.text: No, it's not okay! I don't want to stress you out.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: From the very bottom of my young, trendy heart—my bad.

text_block_list.text: Worn out from all the emotions, Maruzensky gets some rest so she can be ready for the next race.

text_block_list.text: You better believe it! ♪ Lay some more pep talk on me, Trainer!

text_block_list.text: Oh my goodness, Trainer! You sweet-talking flatterer, you! ♪
